entries.speaker: John Doe
entries.text: Good morning everyone. Let's start with the project updates.

entries.speaker: Jane Smith
entries.text: I've completed the database migration. It's ready for testing.

entries.speaker: John Doe
entries.text: Great! Bob, can you test the database changes by end of day today?

entries.speaker: Bob Wilson
entries.text: Sure, I'll run the tests this afternoon and send you the results.

entries.speaker: Jane Smith
entries.text: Also, we need to update the API documentation. John, can you handle that by Friday?

entries.speaker: John Doe
entries.text: Yes, I'll update the docs and push them to the repo by end of week.

entries.speaker: Bob Wilson
entries.text: One more thing - the security audit report needs review. It's high priority.

entries.speaker: Jane Smith
entries.text: I can review that. I'll prioritize it and have feedback by tomorrow.

entries.speaker: John Doe
entries.text: Perfect. Let's also schedule a follow-up meeting for next Monday to review progress.
